editorLoading: The editor is drawn when the page has loaded. The value is in the box below.
profiles.order: The first profile that names a CA in a certificate's validated path covers that certificate, so order matters: put the narrower profile first. Save writes the profiles below as the setting's value; nothing is written until then.
profile.smartCard: The certificates it covers are smart cards (PIV or CAC): a sign-in on one is the authentication policy's smart card row
issuers.heading: Issuers
issuers.note: The CAs the profile covers, each named by the SHA-256 of its SubjectPublicKeyInfo, which a CA certificate renewed under the same key keeps. A certificate is covered when one of them is in its path above it, so a root covers every CA under it.
issuers.needOne: A profile needs at least one issuer; the save refuses one without.
issuers.pick: A CA in the client truststore
issuers.noAnchors: The client truststore holds no CA to pick. Add the card's CA there, or read its certificate below.
issuers.fromCertificate: Or a CA's certificate (PEM), read by the server: each CA certificate in it is added by its SubjectPublicKeyInfo SHA-256
issuers.readNote: {n} issuer(s) read from the certificate and added.
keyUsage.heading: Key usage
keyUsage.note: The keyUsage bits a certificate must carry, every one of them. None ticked asks for none.
eku.heading: Extended key usage
eku.note: The purposes, one of which a certificate must carry. None asks for none.
policies.heading: Certificate policies
policies.note: The policies, one of which RFC 5280 policy processing must carry through the certificate's path, mappings honoured. None asks for none.
bindings.heading: Bindings
bindings.note: How a certificate names its account. Every method ticked is asked; two accounts, or none, sign nobody in. The values are recorded on each person (stsCertificateBinding), on their Credentials → Certificate sign-in tab.
bindings.default: No bindings are written for this profile, so it uses the default: certificate-sha256 and issuer-serial. Ticking or unticking one writes the list.
bindings.high: High affinity: bound to one certificate or one key
bindings.low: Low affinity: a name another certificate may carry
bindings.lowWarn: A name method signs in whoever holds a certificate carrying that name from a covered CA. It is refused unless lowAffinity is ticked, and unticking it takes the name methods out.
listener.label: Label
listener.clientAuthNote: none asks for no certificate; optional asks and accepts a handshake without one; required refuses a handshake without one that chains to the client truststore.
listener.filesNote: Both files or neither: without them this realm's certificate authority issues the listener's certificate and renews it.
listener.tlsNote: A per-listener TLS setting by its short name (minVersion, disableTls12, tls13CipherSuites, pqcOnly, sessionTimeoutS, …) and its value. One left out inherits the service-wide setting.
app.note: Each application, or * for every one not named, and the listeners that answer it; main is the main port. Its URLs are built on the advertised listener, the first when none is chosen.
app.none: No application is mapped: every one is on the main port alone.
pems.subject: Subject
problem.unread: The editor cannot show this value, so it is left to the box below:
problem.notArray: it is not a JSON array.
problem.notObject: it is not a JSON object.
problem.notProfile: a profile is not an object of the members a profile has.
problem.notListener: a listener is not an object of the members a listener has.
problem.notMapping: an application's entry is not an object of listeners and advertised.
problem.inspect: The server could not read the certificate:
problem.lowNeedsOptIn: Tick lowAffinity before choosing a name method.
problem.badHash: An issuer is the SHA-256 of a SubjectPublicKeyInfo: 64 hexadecimal digits.
problem.badOid: That is not a dotted object identifier.
person.heading: Certificate sign-in bindings
person.lead: The values a realm's certificate sign-in profiles find this person by (stsCertificateBinding). A certificate a profile covers signs in the one person holding a value its bindings ask for.
person.none: This person holds no certificate sign-in binding.
person.deriveNote: Paste or choose the person's certificate, with its issuing CA after it if that CA is not in the client truststore. The server reads it and answers spki-sha256, issuer-serial and issuer-ski; Add records one.
person.issuerMissing: Its issuer was not found among the certificates handed in or in the client truststore, so only spki-sha256 is derived. Add the issuing CA's certificate after it to derive the other two.
person.needsWrite: Recording a binding needs Admin Write.
